plan.anchor: first observed view within each contracted unit; earliest canonical source_row selects attributes only among equal view timestamps
plan.category_missing: retained as Unknown plus explicit flag; no later-event imputation
plan.threshold_meaning: Chosen presentation filter, not a power calculation, independent-sample guarantee or significance test. Export all rows and flag those below any threshold.
plan.comparison: Report exact numerator/denominator and descriptive percentage-point gaps to the same cohort overall; no causal lift, significance or expected recovered purchases.
plan.statistics: Confidence intervals, dependence and sensitivity are Chapter 08; do not infer significance from large row counts.
